# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A keyboard key, like shadcn's <Kbd>. Group several keys of a combo with
  # ShortcutKeyGroup.
  class ShortcutKey < Base
    def view_template(&)
      kbd(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "kbd"},
        class: [
          "pointer-events-none inline-flex h-5 w-fit min-w-5 select-none items-center justify-center gap-1",
          "rounded-sm bg-muted px-1 font-sans text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground",
          "in-data-[slot=tooltip-content]:bg-background/20 in-data-[slot=tooltip-content]:text-background",
          "dark:in-data-[slot=tooltip-content]:bg-background/10",
          "[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3"
        ].join(" ")
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Groups the keys of a combo (Ctrl + Shift + P), like shadcn's <KbdGroup>.
  # Renders a <kbd>: nested kbd elements represent a key combination.
  class ShortcutKeyGroup < Base
    def view_template(&)
      kbd(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "kbd-group"},
        class: "inline-flex items-center gap-1"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Shortcut Key

Displays a keyboard key or shortcut.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
div(class: "flex items-center justify-center gap-2") do
  ShortcutKey { "Ctrl" }
  ShortcutKey { "⌘K" }
  ShortcutKey { "Ctrl + B" }
end
```

### Modifier Keys

```ruby
div(class: "flex items-center justify-center gap-2") do
  ShortcutKey { "⌘" }
  ShortcutKey { "C" }
end
```

### Group

```ruby
div(class: "flex justify-center") do
  ShortcutKeyGroup do
    ShortcutKey { "Ctrl" }
    ShortcutKey { "Shift" }
    ShortcutKey { "P" }
  end
end
```

### Arrow Keys

```ruby
div(class: "flex items-center justify-center gap-2") do
  ShortcutKey { "↑" }
  ShortcutKey { "↓" }
  ShortcutKey { "←" }
  ShortcutKey { "→" }
end
```

### In Text

```ruby
p(class: "text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center") do
  plain "Press "
  ShortcutKeyGroup do
    ShortcutKey { "⌘" }
    ShortcutKey { "K" }
  end
  plain " to open the command menu."
end
```
